name: Arduino Uno Rev3

outline.source: Arduino Uno Rev3 mechanical drawing (Arduino): 68.6 x 53.4 mm; the real outline has a stepped right edge and chamfered corners, approximated here as a rectangle

pcb.source: typical FR4 board thickness; not dimensioned on the drawing

mounting_holes.source: Arduino Uno Rev3 mechanical drawing (Arduino): the four holes at (0.55, 0.1), (0.6, 2.0), (2.6, 0.3) and (2.6, 1.4) inches published by Arduino and by designers of Uno cases; pad_diameter 5.0 is an assumed keep-out ring (6.0 would cross the board edge at the 50.8 mm hole)

connectors.name: USB-B
connectors.source: USB-B receptacle about 12 x 10.9 mm, centred at y = 38.1 mm, overhanging the left edge by about 6 mm
connectors.note: position, overhang and height are approximate; measure your board

connectors.name: DC power jack (2.1 mm barrel)
connectors.source: barrel jack about 9 x 11 mm, centred at y = 7.6 mm, overhanging the left edge by about 6 mm
connectors.note: position, overhang and height are approximate; measure your board

omitted: female headers (about 8.5 mm above the PCB, lower than the USB-B and DC jacks; a shield adds its own height)
reset button, ICSP headers, ATmega16U2 and ATmega328P
solder tails of the through-hole parts below the PCB
